description: Sign in with the kernel's API token, clear the onboarding gates, then open one dashboard view and wait for the app shell

path.description: Route to open, e.g. /agents-flow. Real SvelteKit paths — the dashboard stopped using #hash routing.

settle.description: Extra ms to wait after the shell renders, for views that stream their data in.

actions.comment: The shell is gated twice: /api/* answers 401 without a bearer token (the layout's fetch interceptor then bounces to /login), and a missing kernl.setupComplete / kernl.welcomeSeen sends a first-run visitor to /setup. Seeding both from /login — a shell-less page that never triggers either redirect — is what lets the next goto land on the requested view instead of an onboarding screen.
`.sidebar` is the <nav> the layout renders once the shell is up. Waiting on it also proves we did not get bounced to /login or /setup, which render shell-less.
